name: Melenas' Head
summary: Melenas' Head is the severed bounty taken from Lord Melenas, a satyr commander encamped inside Fel Rock. Brought back as absolute proof of his demise, the trophy marks the quiet elimination of a lingering demonic threat on the boughs of Teldrassil.

sections.title: An Unspoken Disgrace
sections.body: To the night elves guarding Shadowglen and the surrounding reaches of Teldrassil, the mere existence of satyrs upon their new World Tree is a bitter disgrace. Lord Melenas chose to make his lair inside the twisted caverns of Fel Rock, just north of the elven settlements, rallying aggressive grell warriors to his banner. Because the kaldorei prize discretion when handling corruptions so close to their heartlands, this bloody trophy serves as private proof that his scheming has been snuffed out before his influence could spread.

faq.answer: Lord Melenas was a satyr commander lurking inside the cave known as Fel Rock on Teldrassil. He gathered a war band of grell under his command to plot against the nearby kaldorei outposts.

faq.q: Why must his death remain quiet?
faq.answer: The presence of satyrs—ancient, cursed night elves twisted by demonic corruption—so close to Teldrassil's sacred boughs is seen as a deep embarrassment by kaldorei authorities. Dealing with him swiftly and quietly prevents panic and minimizes shame.

faq.q: Where was Melenas' Head taken from?
faq.answer: The head is retrieved deep inside Fel Rock, a corrupted cavern located just north of Dolanaar and Shadowglen in central Teldrassil.

angles.text: Satyrs represent a tragic, demonic perversion of ancient night elf lineage, making the quiet execution of Lord Melenas an act of both necessity and cultural shame.
Carrying the severed head of an enemy warlord offers unmistakable, primal proof that a dangerous adversary and his grell host have been broken.
